notes.title: Update 0.1.02
notes.content:
Update 0.1.02 will include the following:

[list]
[*]Improved graphics performance
[*]Many bug fixes
[*]Better UI
[*]Improved enemy AI
[*]Improved trader and items for sale
[*]Online Renown leader board
[/list]

Major features and updates to come!

notes.title: Chaos Theory Pirates
notes.content:
Arghhhh me mateies, ahoy there!

Have been working hard on getting some of the UI fixes in to this latest release which will provide a much better gameplay experience for you all.

In addition to this there are also graphical upgrades utilising Unity's new URP (Universal Render Pipeline) t provide a more graphically pleasing environment. 

Finally there is now a completion criteria that will allow you as a player to complete the game or have the choice to stay on the island and build up more of a base.

Hope you all enjoy and further update will be coming soon!
